blocks.text: Interior design and custom furniture in Prague

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN is an interior design studio with its own furniture production in Bratislava. For clients in Prague, we create design projects, make custom furniture, and deliver projects on a turnkey basis. In Prague, the studio has already completed a 90 m² apartment from start to finish: interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture, and renovation.

The design project can be managed remotely — based on a floor plan, photos, and video calls. We make the furniture in Bratislava, delivery to Prague is included in the price, and our own crew handles installation. Prices are the same as in Bratislava and Vienna.

blocks.text: How we work on properties in Prague

items: Online consultation. We discuss your project by phone, video call, or messenger. You send us a floor plan, photos, and your wishes.
Design project. Layout, concept, 3D visualizations, and technical documentation — everything is approved remotely, and revisions are made based on your comments.

Furniture. Based on the project, we make kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, and other furniture in Bratislava. Before production, we confirm the dimensions — from your measurements or with a site visit by our specialist.
Delivery and installation. We bring the furniture to Prague and install it with our own crew. Delivery is already included in the price.
Turnkey renovation. The whole project can be delivered for you — like the 90 m² apartment in Prague: design, custom furniture, and renovation.

blocks.text: What you can order in Prague

items: Interior design project for an apartment or house — from the layout to working drawings.
3D visualization of an interior or a house facade.
A custom kitchen — a bespoke design or one of the 32 models in our catalog, with delivery and installation.
Custom furniture — wardrobes, walk-in closets, entrance hall furniture, TV walls, and furniture for bedrooms and home offices.
Complete implementation — design, furniture, and renovation by one team.

parts.html: Interior design packages cost the same as for Bratislava and Vienna: from €20/m². Furniture is priced based on the project, and delivery to Prague is already included.

The 90 m² apartment was completed on a turnkey basis: living room, bedrooms, kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, and bathrooms. The kitchen, wardrobes, and storage systems were made to order.

items.q: How much does furniture delivery to Prague cost?
items.a: Delivery is included in the price of the furniture. You get one total price for the pieces with delivery and installation.

For the design project, a floor plan and photos are enough. Before furniture production, we confirm the dimensions either from your own measurements taken according to our instructions or with a site visit by our specialist.
Our own crew from Bratislava. We schedule the installation for the delivery date so that everything is installed in a single visit.

items.q: Can I order just the design project?
items.a: Yes. You will receive a complete set of visualizations and drawings that a local contractor in Prague can work from.
The design project takes from 14 days for the “Express” package; a full project usually takes 4–8 weeks. Furniture production time depends on the scope of the order and is confirmed with the quote.
